skills.name: DataStream Source Creation
skills.description: Micro-skill to instantiate a Flink DataStream from various input sources including in-memory sequences, iterators, generated ranges, or custom connectors. Use when initializing a streaming pipeline with data ingestion.
skills.skill_body:
Select and invoke the appropriate source method based on your data origin:
- Use fromElements() for small in-memory object sequences of uniform type.
- Use fromParallelCollection() with a SplittableIterator for parallel data ingestion from iterators.
- Use generateSequence(from, to) to produce numeric ranges in parallel.
- Use addSource() with a custom source function (e.g., FlinkKafkaConsumer) for external systems.
Ensure the data type is consistent and the source is available before instantiation.

## Objective

Create a DataStream from a specified source
## Applicable Signals

- Starting a new Flink streaming job
- Need to bind data from memory, iterators, sequences, or external systems
- Initializing a streaming pipeline with data ingestion

## Contraindications

- Data is already in a DataStream
- Source is not yet defined or unavailable
- Connector library is not available or not imported
- Data types are heterogeneous (fromElements requires uniform type)

## Intervention Moves

- Invoke fromElements(elements: _*) for uniform-type object sequences
- Invoke fromParallelCollection(SplittableIterator) for parallel iterator ingestion
- Invoke generateSequence(from, to) for numeric range generation
- Invoke addSource(sourceFunction) for custom or external connectors

## Constraints

- All objects in fromElements() must be of the same type
- SplittableIterator must specify the data type of returned elements
- generateSequence() produces numeric sequences only
- Custom source functions must implement the appropriate Flink source interface

## Cautions

- Verify connector availability before using addSource() with external systems
- Ensure type consistency across all elements in the source
- Consider parallelism and performance implications of chosen source method

## Output Contract

- A valid DataStream<T> object ready for downstream transformation or sink operations
